profiles.summary: The stale branch of the execution cache that F-133 names has no seeding read on the default execution paths, so F-133 is cleared for these chains.

deltas.delta: F-133 traced to its seeding read. In revm 42.0.0 the journal returns zero without a database read for the storage of an account created in the transaction (revm-context-interface account.rs lines 172-211), and State::storage returns zero without a database read for an account whose status is LoadedNotExisting, InMemoryChange or one of the Destroyed states (revm-database states/account_status.rs lines 58-67, states/state.rs lines 270-300). Access list slots are only marked warm (journal/inner.rs, warm_addresses). The prewarm path that warms storage slots directly runs only in BlockAccessList mode (payload_processor/prewarm.rs lines 342-431, mod.rs lines 359-368), which needs a block access list that OP Stack and Base blocks do not carry today. No default path therefore puts a storage word of a codeless address that a block destroys and recreates into the cache.

deltas.delta: Soneium's restriction lists are kept by a committee of Soneium core members on criteria about names, copyrighted content and contracts that tools such as Blockaid flag as malicious, with a grace period of about 12 hours, and they are enforced at the RPC level. No rule adds an address from transaction behaviour, so an ordinary account cannot make the PoolManager trip one by sending it dust takes.

cleared.check: Lead L-775 on OP Mainnet, the one endpoint of the unit that mixes builds: do the two backends give the same results for the PoolManager scripts.
cleared.result: 50 requests gave 40 op-reth/v0.0.0-dev-unknown and 10 op-reth/v2.8.1-72207294. Each pmdiff.py script was sent in a batch with web3_clientVersion before and after it and retried until both sides named the wanted build. 246 scripts bracketed by the dev build and 152 bracketed by v2.8.1 return the Ethereum bytes, and every try that got an answer matched on both builds. The other six endpoints and Ink's second endpoint each answered with one build on 50 of 50 requests.

cleared.check: F-133 and lead L-778: which code path puts a storage word of an address without code into the reth execution cache before a block destroys and recreates that address, on op-reth v2.8.1 and v2.8.2 (ethereum-optimism/reth op-v2.6.0-2), conduit-op-reth v2.5.1, world-chain v2.8.2 and base v1.5.6 (base/reth 9e380dd).
cleared.result: None on the default paths. Since Cancun an account is destroyed only in the transaction that created it, so a destroyed account whose original info has no code was created in that block. A storage read of such an address goes to the cache only through State::storage when the account status leaves storage unknown, and revm 42.0.0 returns zero without a read for LoadedNotExisting, InMemoryChange and the Destroyed states (states/account_status.rs lines 58-67, states/state.rs lines 270-300) and for an account created in the transaction (revm-context-interface account.rs lines 172-211). Access list entries only mark slots warm. The only reth path that reads storage slots outside execution is the block access list prewarm (prewarm.rs lines 342-431), which mod.rs lines 359-368 select only when the payload carries a block access list, and OP Stack and Base blocks carry none. The cache entries that the old branch fails to update therefore never exist, the next read misses and goes to the state overlay, and followers cannot be stalled this way. No path reaches the PoolManager in any case: it has code and no SELFDESTRUCT or CREATE (src/PoolManager.sol:279-288 and 349-364 read balances of contracts that already have code). A block access list fork would need a new node release, and base main (base/reth 2b20e42) and op-reth develop (op-v2.7.0-2) already write the recreated account's storage.

cleared.check: Lead L-731: the arithmetic opcode handlers of the respected kona-client prestate itself, run in the Cannon MIPS64 emulator.
cleared.result: Twenty handlers were located in the image and run on every battery and targeted vector of their opcode, with no mismatch: ADD, SUB, DIV, SDIV, MOD, SMOD, EXP, ADDMOD, MULMOD, LT, GT, SLT, SGT, BYTE, AND, OR, XOR, SHL, SHR and SAR. The comparison can fail: a DIV handler run as if it were GT or EQ gave 790 and 773 wrong words. The rules that settle withdrawals on OP Mainnet, Unichain and Ink therefore compute the mulmod of src/libraries/FullMath.sol:24 and :48, the sdiv and smod of src/libraries/TickBitmap.sol:24-26 and the byte lookup of src/libraries/BitMath.sol:22 as the specification says. MUL, SIGNEXTEND and EQ were not located and stay with the cycle 13 rebuild.

cleared.check: Whether Base v1.5.6 runs an interpreter other than revm EthInstructions, or links a ruint release from the October 2026 rewrite, through its evm2 crate.
cleared.result: No. evm.rs fixes EthInstructions with EthInterpreter, the evm2 crate is not wired into the node at v1.5.6 or on main, and the lockfile holds ruint 1.19.0 alone. ruint 1.19.0 is inside RUSTSEC-2026-0220, which cycle 11 showed the shift handlers cannot reach, and no ruint or revm-interpreter release has appeared since 1.21.1 and 43.0.2 (crates.io on 2026-11-25).

cleared.check: Execution stack of op-reth v2.10.0-rc.4, the build Unichain, Ink and Soneium report, against the versions OPCODES.md records.
cleared.result: Unchanged: ruint 1.20.0, revm 43.0.3, revm-interpreter 43.0.2, op-revm 20.0.0, alloy-primitives 1.7.3, fixed-cache 0.1.10, and reth-execution-cache from op-v2.7.0-2 with the fix. No v2.10.0 final or rc.5 tag exists on 2026-11-25.

cleared.check: Upcoming fork, Lagoon, judged from the develop source on 2026-11-25: can a native take (P1), a token take (P2), a sync (P3) or a hook call (P5) aimed at SuperchainETHBridge or ETHLiquidity move value that the caller does not owe.
cleared.result: No. SuperchainETHBridge has no receive or fallback, so a value call with empty calldata from take(address(0), ...) reverts, and sendETH needs its own selector. ETHLiquidity has no receive or fallback; burn and mint revert unless the caller is the bridge, and fund needs its selector. relayETH and refundETH deliver ETH by a self-destructing SafeSend, so ETH sent to the PoolManager raises its balance without msg.value; _settle credits native payments only from msg.value (src/PoolManager.sol:353-354) and the PoolManager has no receive function, so such ETH is credited to nobody and cannot be taken.

leads.question: Locate the MUL, SIGNEXTEND and EQ handlers of the respected kona-client prestate, which the load pattern of find_handlers.py missed, and run them on the battery and targeted vectors.
leads.why: SIGNEXTEND unpacks every tick and BalanceDelta amount (src/libraries/TickBitmap.sol:20-21, TickMath.sol:61). It is covered for the proof program only by the cycle 13 rebuild.

leads.question: After Lagoon activates on OP Sepolia and Unichain Sepolia (target 10 December 2026), read the installed implementations of 0x4200..0022 to 0x28 and 0x30 and send the sixteen call shapes from the PoolManager address.
leads.why: Carries L-352 and L-525 forward. The clearance rests on develop source; an installed version with a payable fallback would make a predeploy a native take recipient.

leadResults.answer: Not active yet. On 2026-11-25 all eight interop proxies on OP Mainnet, Unichain, OP Sepolia and Unichain Sepolia have a zero implementation slot and revert a value call from the PoolManager address with 'Proxy: implementation not initialized'. The registry lists Lagoon as not scheduled. On develop, SuperchainETHBridge and ETHLiquidity have no receive or fallback; SuperchainTokenBridge.sol is not present at the develop path. Carried forward as a new lead.
Same state as L-352 on 2026-11-25: no implementation is installed on any of the four networks, so the sixteen call shapes can only reach the uninitialised proxy, which reverts.

For the seven chains of this unit, only OP Mainnet's endpoint mixes builds (40 dev, 10 v2.8.1 of 50). Pinned by bracketing, the pmdiff scripts match Ethereum on both builds (246 and 152 bracketed scripts, all equal). The other endpoints, and Ink's rpc-qnd endpoint, answered with one build on 50 of 50 requests. The chains of other units in the lead are not covered here.

No default path inserts such a word. revm 42.0.0 answers storage of created, not-existing and destroyed accounts without a database read, access lists only mark slots warm, and the only direct slot warming in reth's prewarm runs on block access lists, which OP Stack and Base blocks do not carry. See the cleared entry for F-133.

Twenty handlers of the real prestate, among them DIV, EXP, ADDMOD, MULMOD and BYTE, were located and match every battery and targeted vector of their opcode. SIGNEXTEND, MUL and EQ were not located and are carried as a new lead.
Not attempted. It is a token sweep, which the owner of this cycle set aside.
